regression_combat_cultist_spawn_bug.json.scenario: Void Convergence Investigation (mixed) @ Abandoned Nexus Research Station - Sublevel 7
regression_combat_cultist_spawn_bug.json.notes: Re-extracted from round 0 for replay compatibility (LLM call_sequence starts at 0). Documents import bug fixed in enemy_combat.py:273. Clock progression: Cultist Reinforcements 0/6→5/6 (rounds 8-11), fills to 9/6 in round 12. With updated prompts, replay should generate enemy_spawns in structured output.

golden_npc_deescalation.jsonl.purpose: Golden fixture for NPC system - demonstrates de-escalation mechanics, stable agent IDs across conversions, civilian fleeing behavior, and NPC LLM client actions. Tests complete NPC lifecycle.
golden_npc_deescalation.jsonl.scenario: Tense Negotiation (social/combat) @ Abandoned Cargo Hub - Contested Territory
golden_npc_deescalation.jsonl.notes: Demonstrates: (1) Fresh NPC spawn with npc_ prefix, (2) Enemy→prisoner de-escalation with stable enemy_ ID preservation, (3) NPC actions (flee, plead, comply, dialogue), (4) Complete JSONL logging (action_declaration + action_resolution). All 3 enemies successfully de-escalate to prisoners via negotiation. 88% action success rate, no errors.

golden_npc_escalation_lifecycle.jsonl.purpose: Golden fixture for full NPC lifecycle - spawn → escalate → de-escalate → prisoner. Tests complete bidirectional conversion system with multiple simultaneous escalations.
golden_npc_escalation_lifecycle.jsonl.scenario: Hostile Takeover Gone Wrong (social/combat) @ Condemned Warehouse - Freeborn No-Man's-Land
golden_npc_escalation_lifecycle.jsonl.notes: Demonstrates: (1) 3 NPCs spawned from config with distinct threat levels, (2) All 3 NPCs escalate simultaneously in Round 1 (NPC→enemy), (3) Escalated NPCs use enemy combat AI (Razor shoots Brick for 11 damage), (4) 2 de-escalations to prisoners in Rounds 2-3 (enemy→prisoner), (5) Agent ID preservation through multiple conversions, (6) DM personality-based escalation reasoning. Stress test for simultaneous conversions. 60% action success rate, 0 errors. Config: session_config_npc_escalation_ultraviolent.json.
